title: Applied field practice
summary: Use technical knowledge in discovery, demonstrations, bounded proofs of value and clear follow-up.
outcomes: Connect a customer decision to evidence, scope and ownership.
Explain an outcome honestly, including failures and uncertainty.
startingAssumptions: Professional application material; not official onboarding or interview/level scoring.
Browse technical topics directly when a concept is unfamiliar.
